headline: This law renames a post office in Fairhope, Alabama, after William Jack Jackson Edwards III.
what_it_does: It officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 509 Fairhope Avenue in Fairhope, Alabama, as the William "Jack" Jackson Edwards III Post Office Building. The change is symbolic and does not alter how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
